nodes.label: Information Systems Theory
nodes.rationale: Laudon and Laudon (2022) define how data is collected, processed, and transformed into actionable intelligence using input-process-output structures and feedback loops to support data integrity.

nodes.label: Service Management Theory
nodes.rationale: Grönroos (2021) outlines bridging the service-gap between office coordination and field execution, ensuring competence verification and systematic deployment.

nodes.label: ISO/IEC 25010 Quality Model
nodes.rationale: Provides an international software quality framework focusing on functional suitability, usability, reliability, and performance efficiency to predict user adoption.

nodes.label: Iterative SDLC Model
nodes.rationale: Methodology framework used for continuous refinement of the complex Geofencing API and Biometric Authentication subsystems based on iterative user feedback cycles.

nodes.label: Geofenced Attendance Validation
nodes.rationale: Uses GPS boundaries mapping to restrict clock-in/out to approved sites, preventing time/wage theft.

nodes.label: Biometric Fingerprint Authentication
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint verification for identifying workers physically, preventing proxy clock-ins ('buddy punching').

nodes.label: GPS Integrity & Spoofing Detection
nodes.rationale: Verifies GPS spoofing by checking location.mocked and coords.accuracy (> 50m) in useGeofence.ts to ensure integrity of time logs.

nodes.label: Offline Queue & Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Ensures offline-first capability by caching DTR logs/checkouts in AsyncStorage FIFO queue (syncQueue.ts) and auto-polling to sync when connection restores.

nodes.label: Secure Offline Auth & Biometric Gating
nodes.rationale: Caches credentials in SecureStore under USER_SESSION with a 24-hour TTL and locks/unlocks the client via expo-local-authentication biometric prompts.

nodes.label: Statutory Payroll Compliance Engine
nodes.rationale: Calculates gross pay dynamically via verified time logs, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG deductions matrix, and holiday multiplier calculations.

nodes.label: Interactive Geofence Map Editor
nodes.rationale: Integrates Leaflet on admin side for draggable marker and boundary setup, and react-native-maps on mobile side for distance tracking visualizers.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control Privilege Separator
nodes.rationale: Enforces distinct system scopes: Super Admins control settings/compliance overrides, Standard Admins maintain daily directories, and Supervisors have tenant branch isolation.

nodes.label: Inventory Control & Reconciliation Audits
nodes.rationale: Manages stocks, restocks, low stock alert flags, and performs quarterly physical count reconciliations utilizing correcting variance ledger postings.

nodes.label: Jira Headless API Client
nodes.rationale: Uses a direct script-based Node.js HTTPS client to interface with Jira backlog synchronization to prevent Google SSO browser-lock errors.
